title: Internal Complaints Committee | KPGU
content: marked International Women's Day (IWD) to renew collective commitment to achieving gender equality. The event was graced by distinguished university leadership along with 181-ABHYAM Women Helpline team and SHE team, Vadodara. 05/03/2024 Empowerment Through Art: Poster Making Competition The poster competition titled "The Empowerment Through Art" was formulated with a comprehensive aim of fostering self-awareness among university staff and students on 5 March and 6 March 2024.
